structured_output.confidence_explanation: Funnel data clearly localizes the redemption-rate drop to east/full_service on 08-31 and 09-01 with upstream stages stable, but activity data (which would reveal incentive/rule changes at the redemption stage) is entirely missing and could not be retrieved, so the causal mechanism cannot be established.

hypotheses.statement: East/full_service redemption rate dropped sharply on 08-31 (0.345455) and 09-01 (0.330729) versus a stable ~0.68-0.71 baseline from 08-18 to 08-30, while upstream funnel stages (impressions, visits, enrollments, confirmations) remained stable. This localizes the anomaly specifically to the confirmation→redemption stage, not to upstream traffic or enrollment.
hypotheses.uncertainty: The causal driver at the redemption stage is unknown because activity data (incentives, redemption rules, merchant-side changes) is missing and could not be retrieved; the drop could stem from an incentive/rule change, a redemption-channel outage, or data/reporting issues.

hypotheses.statement: The user premise notes activity data is missing, and query_activity calls for full_service and for the whole period both failed with invalid_arguments, returning no activity records. Without activity-level data, any redemption-stage mechanism (e.g., incentive cancellation, redemption channel closure) cannot be confirmed or ruled out.
hypotheses.uncertainty: It is unknown whether the activity data absence is a data-availability gap or reflects that no activity was running; this cannot be distinguished from available evidence.

requested_data: Activity-level data for east/full_service covering 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-01 (and the prior baseline 08-18 to 08-30) showing any incentive/redemption-rule changes, redemption-channel status, or merchant-side events at the confirmation→redemption stage.
Whether the missing activity data reflects a genuine data-availability gap versus no activity running, and any redemption-stage operational or reporting changes effective 08-31.
